speaker: 宾客一
cn: 这可是在教堂，没想到新娘逃婚了，新郎还在这儿看这种视频……真是荒唐！
en: This is a church! I never expected the bride to run away from the wedding, while the groom is still watching this kind of video... It's utterly absurd!

speaker: Damián
cn: 你知道这是什么吗？这是我们家的监控！逃婚的新娘正在我的床上跟别人做爱！
en: Do you know what this is? This is our home surveillance footage! The bride who fled the wedding is having sex with someone else on MY bed!

speaker: 宾客二
cn: 看来今天的婚礼应该是取消了，大家就先离开吧。
en: It seems today's wedding has been canceled; everyone, please leave the church.

speaker: Damián (VO)
cn: （愤恨）Eloísa，今天是我们结婚的日子，你却在家跟Julián偷情！真是贱人！
en: (resentfully) Eloísa, you are cheating on me with Julián at home on our wedding day! Bitch!

speaker: Damián
cn: （皱眉）Eloísa，是你说今天结婚的。教堂我约好了，神父也来了，可你呢？现在都散场了你还不出现！
en: (frowning) Eloísa, you wanted to get married today. I've already made an appointment at the church, and the priest is here; but what about you? All the guests are leaving, yet you still haven't shown up.

speaker: Eloísa (OS)
cn: （忍着声音，满不在乎）不好意思啊Damián，Julián生病了，我得照顾他。啊～
en: (holding back her voice, nonchalant) I'm sorry, Damián—Julian is sick; I have to take care of him. Ah...

speaker: Damián
cn: Eloísa，既然今天结婚你不来，那我们就分手吧！
en: Eloísa, you missed our wedding. We are done!

speaker: Damián
cn: （皱眉）嘶！（打开手看伤口）这是什么破钻戒！
en: (frowning) Hiss! (opens his hand to look at the wound) What kind of lousy ring is this?

speaker: 戒指（OS）
cn: （低沉，带回声）又是一位被命运捉弄的继承者……欢迎。这枚戒指，已历经七代主人的悲欢离合。你在此地流下了血，命运的齿轮已然转动——此后每到命运的岔路口，我便为你记录节点，并赐你所需。
en: (deep, echoing, like a hundred-year-old butler)Yet another heir tormented by fate… Bienvenido.  Your blood has roused me forth. Seven bearers have struck this pact before you. At every fateful turning-node ahead, I shall chronicle your fate and grant you power to change your course…

speaker: Damián
cn: （懵）继承者？这戒指里……住了个人？
en: (dazed) Heir? Is there… someone living inside this ring?

speaker: 男人（OS）
cn: （低沉）首个命运节点已记录。地点：Cathedral Metropolitana（大都会主教座堂）。命运馈赠——一位值得你的新娘。
en: (deep)First fate-node recorded. Location: Cathedral Metropolitana. Fate's offering—a bride worthy of you.

speaker: Damián
cn: （懵）命运馈赠一个新娘？我不会是被气疯了吧？
en: (confused) Reward the bride? I must’ve been out of my mind with rage!

speaker: Isadora
cn: （皱眉打量Damián）刚才听他们说，新娘逃婚了。你就是那个新郎？
en: (frowning and looking Damián up and down) I just heard the bride ran away. Are you the groom?

speaker: Isadora
en: Okay, you're the one. Marry me
